userFacing.summary: One-step updater rollback: every update snapshots the previous version and its settings first, Help › Roll Back to Mark… restores the snapshot together with the settings it had before the update, and the version being left is skipped until a newer release ships; if an update breaks startup the same restore runs from the terminal before the UI boots (mark --rollback, --yes for scripts).
